title: Blog Posts for 2025 (Dynamics 365 Lab)
summary: This page indexes dozens of blog posts about Dynamics 365 Business Central published throughout 2025 and early 2026, covering copilot and agent capabilities, customization techniques, AL development, administration, reporting, data integration, and feature announcements across multiple release waves.
